description: A new turbidity analyzer in the Filtration area shares VLAN 13 with PLC-2 rather than sitting on its own segment. No ACL boundary separates them -- by definition of sharing an L2 segment there is nothing at Layer 3 to enforce. Supporting documentation (supporting_note_07a.md) gives a hazardous-area electrical classification rationale for why introducing a second network device there was not feasible. This is the first concrete test case for CPG 3.I's own 'where safe and technically feasible' scope language.

flows.notes: PLC-2 and the new turbidity analyzer (10.13.0.12) on the same VLAN 13 segment, no L3 boundary between them
